status: Line-relative statistics and doubtful-sign inclusion verified; exact damage-edge allocation rule not established

definitions.finding: Distribution analysis uses a line because sequence continuity and order among lines of one object or side are not known in advance; numbering of sides/lines is provisional
Positions are solus (one sign forming the whole line), initial, medial, final, all relative to a line
Asterisk marks doubtful sign reading; hatched loss passage may contain one or more signs, whose number cannot be counted
Concordance includes each legible occurrence, explicitly including starred doubtful signs, once
Concordance listing order uses whole-text positions; this differs from Table I line-level positions
Table I uses a line as unit; whole-text statistics can instead be collected from Concordance
Notes define SOL/INI/MED/FIN/TOT and reiterate line as unit; no explicit algorithm for damaged-edge allocation is supplied

doubtful_sign_tally_conclusion.directly_verified: Starred occurrences are included in the legible-sign concordance inventory
doubtful_sign_tally_conclusion.table_I_inference: Table I total matches the stated legible-sign corpus total; do not remove doubtful signs when attempting exact reconstruction without an explicitly labelled subset. Separate starred and unstarred tallies remain useful.

not_established: Whether each known sign adjacent to an edge loss block is counted initial/final or medial
Whether a line containing one surviving sign plus damage may ever enter solus
Any fixed length for loss marker
damage_position_limit.constraint: Do not silently remove000 or collapse damaged edges before calculating positions and calling the result equivalent to Table I.
